policy: All 717 original source blocks retained. Section and scenario dispositions are maintainer-reviewed scope assignments, not automatic semantic test coverage. A mixed row passes only its explicitly described M1 slice and recorded automated environments. The original full-clause status remains unverified. Context rows carry no invented execution requirement. Later gates are obligations, not exceptions.

foundation.title: Reproduction, exports and declarations
foundation.scope: Compiled private native slice, zero runtime deps, supported compiler consumers; later adapters/catalog excluded.

registration.title: Inert imports and compatible registration
registration.scope: Explicit native registration, same-build independently evaluated copies and typed conflict; register-all/catalog later.

readiness.title: Application-owned native state and outcomes
readiness.scope: Pending/ready/refresh/replacement, ready mount, empty/zero, error/cancel/retry/stale-response recipe, independent regions.

identity-events.title: Stable content, interruption and committed events
identity-events.scope: Original app nodes, handlers/input, latest revision, atomic updates and one terminal per start in tested native flow.

focus.title: Replacement focus and immediate ready controls
focus.scope: Native focus-before-hide, no restoration, deep shadow ownership, authored host semantics and focus settlement; manual AT/modal app integrations later.

motion.title: Finite native motion and restrictions
motion.scope: Native pulse/dissolve finite effects, pause/OS/ancestor/offscreen/zero/reconnect and four-second wall window. Post-stall settlement is not external pixel/flash analysis.

browserFixtures.titlePrefix: native pulse has a finite effect

configuration.title: Options, themes, presets and recovery
configuration.scope: Skeleton/region property configuration and local styles; actual text remains app-owned. Exact glyph treatments and complete catalog later.

static-csp.title: Static native and request-scoped CSP
static-csp.scope: App-templated native server-ready/pending/refresh, explicit app availability guards, failed/disabled/delayed JS, CSP headers/Trusted Types. DSD/framework streaming/hydration not shipped.

extension.title: Typed authoring and bounded custom effects
extension.scope: Implemented skeleton idle/still and region handoff/targets, finite bounded commands, captured options/easing, geometry/ownership failure fallback. Dense providers/rich repertoire later.

cleanup.title: Operational disposal and preliminary retention
cleanup.scope: 100 reconnects, direct package observer/listener/frame teardown, ten-second paused inactivity, same-origin adoption and local CDP preliminary collection. Full physical heap protocol remains M7.

provenance.title: Ownership, privacy and publication blocks
provenance.scope: Exact m37 reference fingerprints, no copied source; private flags, fail-closed installed lifecycle, no registry/deployment actions.

docs.title: Native runnable example and accurate scope
docs.scope: Packed native app fixture/types with state ownership, all CSP modes and static recipe. Full docs/playground website belongs to M5.

M2.scope: Dense renderer/projection/scheduling comparison and initial benchmark implementation; physical reference qualification still required.

M3.scope: React adapter and Next/DSD/streaming/hydration/navigation, full server integration and peer matrix. No M1 framework claim.

M4.scope: Remaining native exports, rich text/chart/table/typing, complete preset/geometry/repertoire/defaults and full family/catalog size limits.

M5.scope: Marketing/docs/gallery/playground, generated examples/search/version/sharing, site navigation and accessibility; website performance separate.

M6.owner: owner for access/exposure approval; maintainer for checks
M6.scope: Protected personal-team alpha, verified access controls and findings; no deployment authorized by M1.

M7.owner: maintainer and human accessibility/device testers; owner for access
M7.scope: Full floor/current branded browser/real-device/manual AT/Windows forced-colors/zoom/flash and physical reference timing/heap/100-cycle matrices, reviewed commit and final catalog artifacts. M1 automation is scoped evidence only.

M8.owner: owner for independent release approvals and account security; maintainer for execution
M8.scope: Final namespace/auth, trusted publication/provenance/bootstrap/registry/tag/recovery, independent source/npm/site authorizations. No registry publication in M1.

M9.qualificationGate: before any paid sale or stated maintenance claim
M9.owner: owner for commercial/license/capacity decisions; maintainer for delivery
M9.scope: Post-launch maintenance/support/deprecation and optional paid demand/pilot/customer entitlement/discontinuation obligations. Free catalog remains prerequisite.
